content:
zoe: FYI PolarisEdge sent their compliance bundle for marketplace listing. It contains full firmware images, manifest.json (with serials, hw_id), SOC2 excerpt, and a pen-test summary. Legal/security asked for a reproducible publish/playbook.
kai: Can we confirm what goes PUBLIC vs RESTRICTED vs ARCHIVE?
jules-partner: PolarisEdge prefers only metadata public. They'll provide attestation and NDA for reviewers.
harper-legal: Legal rule: PUBLIC = redacted manifest + SOC2 controls summary + one-line attestation. RESTRICTED = presigned access to firmware and full pen-report for NDA'd reviewers. ARCHIVE = raw evidence in KMS bucket (security+legal+partner-liaison). Need an evidence-access addendum.
ashley-sec: Security checklist: - Redact unique identifiers (serial, hw_id, mac, device_key, internal_host) - Replace with deterministic placeholders so reviewers can correlate (use SHA256 prefix) - Remove any PEM blobs from public artifacts - Compute & store SHA256 of raw and redacted artifacts in audit log - Presign TTL default 7d, require access ticket + approver.
zoe: Quick jq example to share with partners to pre-redact manifest.json: ```bash
jq '.serial = "REDACTED" | .hw_id = "REDACTED" | del(.signer_cert)' manifest.json > manifest.public.json
```
kai: Deterministic placeholder suggestion (python): ```python
import hashlib

def placeholder(v):
    return 'REDACTED-'+hashlib.sha256(v.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
```
ashley-sec: Ops presign example (AWS CLI): ```bash
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/polarisedge/firmware-v1.tar.gz --expires-in 604800
```
ops-bot: ops-bot  ticket created: MP-9001 presign gating + audit capture; runbook stub: https://confluence.redwood.internal/marketplace/polarised-playbook :ticket:
harper-legal: Draft listing copy: "Sensitive device identifiers and internal configuration details have been removed from the public package. Full artifacts are available to authorized reviewers under NDA." I'll finalize wording and the one-page evidence addendum.
jules-partner: We'll provide the signed attestation PDF and a contact for the pen-test witness. Also will pre-run a manifest with placeholder mapping if you share the mapping rules.
ashley-sec: small runbook steps for internal ops: 1) validate partner upload 2) run deterministic redaction lambda (store mapping in ephemeral store) 3) compute SHA256 (raw + redacted) 4) publish public bundle to marketplace assets 5) archive raw evidence in KMS bucket with MFA delete + 12mo retention 6) create presign only after access ticket approval 7) log audit entry with requester, approver, purpose, hashes.
kai: I'll own the redaction run and presign for the first upload. Timeline: redaction + public bundle today, presign to reviewers tomorrow after NDA.
ops-bot: ops-bot  suggested IAM pattern: ephemeral reviewer role scoped to specific S3 prefix + condition on requesterTicketId; CloudTrail events captured and pushed to audit S3 prefix.
harper-legal: Please ensure SOC2 excerpt is redacted of auditor PII and contact details. Limit it to control narratives (change mgmt, key custody).
zoe: Good. Marking this thread canonical for PolarisEdge marketplace artifact flow. Kai will post presign link + SHA256 here once ready. Ping @zoe if anything slips. :lock: :white_check_mark:
